faq.q: What is Malibu Club in GTA 6?
faq.a: Malibu Club is a night club listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Malibu Club confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Malibu Club as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Malibu Club?
faq.a: The wiki gives 3 details. Place type: night club. Scope: single site. Coordinates: not given. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Malibu Club information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Malibu Club, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Malibu Club?
faq.a: Most of it. Malibu Club rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Where it sits on the map and whether the player can go inside are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Malibu Club be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of landmark entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
